Answer: B
Reason: Comparing the first image (pre-operative) with the second image (post-operative), there is a marked increase in the width of the superior mediastinum and new right basilar opacity/effusion. In the context of a known thyroid angiosarcoma, this rapid enlargement of the mediastinal mass is most indicative of aggressive tumor recurrence rather than a stable post-surgical change or successful removal.
